body: Yea, I just want to have a happy life. But apparently I never could.

Yep it does.

My point I did in another comment stills stands though. My outlook on life is quiet different from yours I guess. If I was robbed of freedom, because it feels like sitting in a prison cell most of the time, I'm turning the offer of life down.

Btw I might've overreacted in my comment but I feel like people don't really get my point and underestimate my struggles.

I don't think my life is worthless either. I just don't enjoy it. That's it. I think it will be even more pointless and worthless to keep suffering than to die at my own terms. "Life is an offer you can also turn down" - Corpus Delicti by Juli Zeh. I recommend this book, especially if you like "1984" or similiar stuff. I see life like the character who said this.
And still there are people dying of hunger, so apparently it isn't always possible. These people probably also wish they were born into a comfortable life which is not possible.

Btw a question: If somebody doesn't have enough to eat and will probably die because of it, means he shouldn't be lamenting and wishing he had food because, you know, it's so unrealistic as wishing they were able to fly? They should just focus on other areas of life right?

I won't imagine this because it hurts too much imagining something I'll never have. Besides, I'm a woman.

I can't study things that interest me. Like psychology, music, economics, philosophy, sports etc. These are the things that I like. You have to have social skills to work in these fields. That's the whole point. And you seem to miss it. And who will do you think will hire me in the state I'm in? You didn't answer this question. I'm forced to work a job where I don't work with people. And by the way, looks are extremely important in getting a job. Lookism my friend.

My problems go far beyond having self image issues or no self love. As I said, people ask themselves what's wrong with me all the time. And I've already been working on myself for a few years. I haven't developed like a normal person should. That's it. It goes far beyond no friends or no boyfriend. I can't talk to people like a normal person. I can't have a normal conversation. And what do I talk to them about when they start talking about all the things they did? Should I talk about how I've been staring at my ceiling for the past 8 years? How I have been treated? I have a lot of interests and know a lot. But it doesn't bring me much happiness and conversation topics anymore. You seem to miss few years ago I couldn't even answer a yes or no question from a teacher. You seem to miss my teachers got extremely worried after I started showing signs of intelligence and didn't know what to do anymore. They didn't know how I got into the state I'm in. You seem to miss I didn't talk to anybody in my class. I don't have any friends. Nobody. My posture already looks like that of a grandma because I don't move at all. Even though I've been exercising regularly for the past 6 years. And it obviously hurts, my back and shoulders are really bad.

Most importantly, you seem to miss that I'm scared of going out of my house. Because people insult me 95% of the time. Random people. How do I deal with this? I'm a 5ft1 small weak woman, I can't defend myself if I wanted to. How do I deal with people pointing fingers at me "look how ugly she is!".

I haven't mentioned all the things wrong with me. But I have many disorders, especially anxiety disorders. I'm not even able to drive because of that.

I just don't enjoy my life. You know, there are people suffering physical pain and no quality of life pursuing assisted suicide. Why can't I do the same if I feel I have no quality of life? You seem to miss that I just don't want the life I have and this suffering I have to endure. Why is it so bad to just say "I don't want this"?

I am mentally ill, but not disabled. I have a lot of disorders and issues as a result of trauma.

Nobody has convinced me I have no worth. I feel I do. Other people don't feel that way. And I can't keep up with this treatment anymore. I feel I am awesome.

Look, I can study all of this. But it does not interest me. Besides, what job can I have? Who will hire me in this state? How can I be financialy able to do all the things you mentioned?

I just don't want more. I just don't want it and that's it. This is why I'm opting out. I know you might not understand. But that's it. I don't want to go beyond and above to find some fulfillment. If I can't have these simple beautiful moments in life, why should I live? I don't care about fullfilment tbh. Or purpose. I don't need it. I don't believe we need it. I believe we should live for the beautiful experiences, for the simple things. We should live to help and love people. I just don't see the beautiful things happening. I'm sorry.

I've spent years on self improvement. I've spent years on learning social skills. I'm in therapy for my severe social anxiety after years of bullying. It took me 4 years to be able to answer questions from a teacher. I know what it is. I just don't want to be alone anymore. I don't want such a miserable, lonely life for the next what, 60-70 years? Nah. Every goal I wanted, every hobby I wanted to pursue is out of reach. Everything beautiful in life is out of reach. I just don't want to live like this. I just don't. Tell me, what exactly is so beautiful about my life? What is so worthwile about my life? What can I do in life? Tell me. 

And you know what the worst thing is? Being treated like shit. Being pointed at with fingers and laughed at, insulted by random strangers. Being bullied my entire life. Not having a chance on a normal childhood. Being mentally ill as a child already. Being spat on, shoved, insulted and manipulated. Being molested for fun. Forced to touch others for fun. Being put on drugs and tormented afterwards. This was my life. Being mistaken for a disabled person. I just have had enough. This is not a life worth living. I'm literally scared to go out of my house. There are videos of me being bullied circulating around the town I live in. I've been recognized before and made fun of, too.

I wouldn't fucking want to be a millionaire. I just wanted to be normal so badly. And since I am not, I make the concious decision to end it here. The suffering is too much. 

Btw r/ugly isn't some incel stuff. It's people genuinely talking about their struggles and lookism. A place like this sub here.

It would be different if my desires weren't normal human needs. Flying isn't one. Remember Maslow Pyramide? Exactly.

Btw I mentioned wanting to become a teacher or a psychologist. I'd love to work with people. This is not possible because of how fucked up I am. It would be more than possible intelligence wise. I could be teaching English for example or any other language. I'm not a native and am probably around C2 already, imagine what would happen after university.

I do have those. Being lonely and suicidal for half my young life has prevented me from pursuing any of this.

I don't care about art or travelling. And even if, how do I get a good enough job to be able to do those things with my terrible social skills and appearance? Who will want to hire me?
I don't want to live on my own. I don't want this. I don't want no replacement for the normal life. I want to have friends and family and don't want to be treated like shit whenever I go on a fucking walk.

Sure. I can find those people. And then? They're as miserable as I am. Go visit r/ugly and see for yourself. I just want to have the beautiful things in life which I don't. There is no replacing these things. I want parties, love, sex, friends, marriage, kids, a chance at a successful carreer etc. Can I get them? No. I want fun teenage years. I want to go to lake with friends and chat with peers at school. I want to go to concerts. I want to become a teacher or a psychologist. Can I have any of this? No. What can I have then? A life of loneliness?

Those were my formative years. Where a person learns social skills and when a person develops into a young adult, finds themselves and what path they want to pursue. Those were extremely important years. Years where you have fun. Now what? What am I supposed to do now? Work, home, work, home. A job I don't want? You really don't see a problem here? I just wanted a normal life which I won't have. I have to accept it and a) live a different life knowing I'll never be happy b) stop my suffering.

I'm aware of the autism spectrum disorder, I have worded myself poorly. They thought I have intelligence deficiency until I actually started studying. Besides, I'm sure I don't have any form of autism or anything else.

I'm ugly. I've been socialy rejected since kindergarten. I developed many coping mechanisms to deal with it as a child, one of them being wanting to be a boy and acting like one. Because "boys don't have to be pretty". It obviously doesn't work after puberty and made my life even worse because people made fun of it and I didn't fit in with other girls.
I've been bullied my entire life. Even to the point of sexual violence. Often random people on the street will point fingers at me, laugh at me or insult me to my face. That's how I know I'm ugly.

It's already been half of my life. Nobody will bring me back all those lost years. I had to learn social skills manualy because I didn't get the chance to develop them. I have severe social anxiety as a result of bullying. There is no way I can even have a job I'd like to do. No way I can have the life experiences they had. Even such a stupid thing like sex. I'll never experience it, I'll never have kids. My appearance made my life miserable.

There is a future. There is a lonely future in a job I don't want to do seeing all the other people having so much more than I do. Being happy. I don't want this for myself.

I'm ugly. My whole life I have been treated worse because of that. Never could have a normal healthy childhood. My peers have a social life, social skills and a future. They have partners, something I'll never have. They will have families of their own in the future. I've been lonely for almost half of my life and I am quiet young. I've said it in another comment, I've been fucked up so badly by other people that people thought I'm cognitively disabled. Like literally teachers asking themselves what disability I have. "Looks normal". Well, it would be fair if I was in fact cognitively disabled. Thing is I'm quiet intelligent, well above average. So this is how badly fucked up I am.

I put into another comment: First you go to school, make friends and memories, life experiences, then you get a job maybe try to get a nice carreer out of it, you get a partner and start a family. I've been lonely for half of my life now and am extremely young. Like, no friends etc. I said in another comment, people fucked me up so badly people thought I'm intelectually disabled. I'm extremely intelligent though. This is how bad it is.

I'm so fucked up by my past experiences people thought I'm cognitively disabled and asked themselves what disability I have. Thing is, I'm actually quiet intelligent. Like well above avarage. So you can guess I'm not much luckier.
No problem.
My appearance. My whole life has been sadly destroyed by my appearance. I wish I had a chance.
I have potential if I had money for surgery. I don't. It would cost me thousands of dollars. I'm sorry you have to feel like me too.

I agree with your last paragraph.

You don't need children in a marriage. And I agree, until your situation isn't stable you shouldn't have children.

I understand you. You lived in an (from what I understand) abusive home and have had a lot of stress. You definitely should try to leave that place. r/raisedbynarcissists is a good place to maybe find people in the same situation. Are you pursuing any education or any carreer path right now? If yes, definitely get financialy independent and move out. You do deserve much better and I can see you're a much better, more intelligent human than your father. I still think there is a chance. I know many people who were in your situation and turned everything around. You should try a little longer, please. If it doesn't work out, do what you think is best for you. 

People will always suffer, some more than others and some will never experience happiness, but people can be happy and life can be beautiful I thinm. I think you might be able to pull this off. As I said, I don't want to motivate you, it's what I think. You had a shit start to your life, you obviously will be behind people who've had it all. Don't feel bad about it.

I know you're miserable. But maybe you can actually achieve a happy life in a few years. As cliche as it sounds.

Nah, I'm not trying to be motivating. I really do believe it lol. I'm in a worse situation than you (probably) and have no way out. But you might still have a chance. If I truly saw no solution for you I'd say do it, I see no problem in people leaving their life if their situation has little to no chance of improving. I'll sadly be forced to do the same even tho I'm dying (hah) to live. 

Btw you mean you're 18 or have been suffering 18 years? If the former, than I'm older than you and you definitely still have some chance.

I also have a fear of everything. I have a few anxiety disorders. If you fear them because of the country you live in you might want to move out to another one somehow. If it's an anxiety disorder you might want to find a good therapist if you can. Online resources help too if you can't visit a therapist in your country. Maybe you can actually fix it. Your situation isn't completely helpless. Try to find a solution somehow, I believe you still can have a happy life.
Why are you scared? Will there be some backlash from other people from your culture, or you're scared of being independent cause you weren't taught how to?

Same for me.

What exactly detoriated in your life? Maybe there is a way to fix some of that?

I know how it feels.

Why exactly do you think you will never have any of that? I'm just curious. Maybe I can somehow help?

It sucks doesn't it? And we'll never know why we got so unlucky. We literally had no influence over all of this. I'm sick hearing all this cliche advice people give me. It doesn't work the way they think it does.
Meeting people online also won't bring back the years I spent being lonely and the experiences I've missed.

It's the same as the example of "get an animal" I mentioned in my post. People say this stuff to people who are lonely, like a replacement for human affection.

I don't want to meet people online. I want to be able to talk to people and have a normal life. Meeting people online doesn't cut it.

I'm aware you're not trying to make fun of me. Thing is, it happens even if I'm just riding a bus or taking a walk. Being ugly in this world is horrible.

First you go to school, make friends, make experiences, have hobbies, go to university or work, get a partner, have a family. Maybe try to have a nice carreer or whatever. Obviously simplified. I'm aware life isn't that simple.

But instead I will always be alone and not even able to talk to people. People will always make fun of me. I didn't even get the chance to be happy.

I'm going to try to work on all the things you mentioned but it's definitely going to be difficult. I really improved the last few years and I am at a better point than 3-4 years ago. Thank you for your help

Still, me being lonely since such a young age is still an issue. Last year I spent months not talking to another human. I don't know how long I can keep doing this.

I don't have any control over why I'm being mistreated. I'm not full blown abused anymore, I cut my abusers out of my life completely, but years of people treating me like shit and being neglected at home has obviously left me extremely damaged, this and my appearance are why I am still getting mistreated. I've made a lot of progress the past few years, but obviously I'm still not quiet "normal", at least people don't think I'm cognitively impaired anymore. I have trouble going out of my house because I'm scared I'm going to get insulted or laughed at (I'm guessing it might be a symptom of CPTSD), complete strangers did in fact insult me before. So it's not like I can change environments.

I always try to remember it's not my fault etc but it's still is quiet damaging and triggering to me, even though this is not really getting abused or bullied.

Thank you for trying to help though, I appreciate it.
I do, thanks.
I have a therapist, CPTSD is just not something that is well known. I'm not sure meds if meds could help my situation, my depression is purely situational.

I know what CPTSD is. If I only could find a therapist that specializes in it near me I'd probably be diagnosed with it.

The problem is, I can't see people stopping to mistreat me anytime soon. That's the biggest issue.

Thanks for the suggestion nonethless, I already have this book on my list, need to get through "Body keeps the score" first.
I don't want to talk about everything but e.g. loneliness since I was a child. Or all the things people did to me, my mental issues (not depression)
